title: Best Automatic Cleaners for Vinyl Pools
summary: Check out our guide for the best suction side, pressure side, or robotic pool cleaners to keep your vinyl pool clean and safe!
body_markdown:
Vinyl pool liners are smooth, comfortable, and easy to maintain, but they need a little extra care. Sharp edges, worn parts, or a cleaner designed for rough concrete can scuff, stretch, or damage the liner.


The good news is that plenty of automatic cleaners are made to work safely on vinyl. The right choice depends on whether your pool is in-ground or above ground, the type of debris you collect, and whether you want a cleaner that works independently or uses your existing pool equipment.


## Why You Need a Vinyl-Friendly Cleaner


Not all pool surfaces are created equal, and neither are all automatic pool cleaners. Vinyl-lined pools are more sensitive and susceptible to surface damage than concrete or gunite pools. Automatic pool cleaners designed for vinyl pools have soft and smooth wheels and cleaning mechanisms to protect the vinyl lining. Using the wrong automatic cleaner in your vinyl pool can cause surface scrapes, tears, or more severe damage.


Here are some of the best vinyl-friendly automatic pool cleaners available at Leslie's.

## Pressure-Side Cleaners for Vinyl Pools


**[Pressure-side automatic cleaners](https://lesliespool.com/pressure-cleaners/)** are a great option for vinyl pools, because they are cost effective and preserve your pool filter. These cleaners connect to your pool system's return jet and use the water pressure to move around the pool. The bag attached to the cleaner collects dirt, leaves, and other debris directly, keeping it out of the filter. This means a longer filter lifespan and less filter cleaning! Let's take a closer look at some of the top-rated pressure-side cleaners.

## Suction-Side Cleaners for Vinyl Pools


**[Suction-side cleaners](https://lesliespool.com/suction-cleaners/)** connect to the skimmer or a dedicated suction line and use the pool pump to vacuum dirt and debris. They do not require a booster pump, but everything they collect travels into the pump basket and filter. That may mean more frequent filter cleaning, especially during heavy debris periods.

## Robotic Cleaners for Vinyl Pools


**[Robotic cleaners](https://lesliespool.com/robotic-cleaners/)** work independently from the pool pump and filter. They collect debris in their own basket or canister and require no booster pump. They usually cost more upfront, but offer the most hands-off cleaning and can reduce the amount of debris reaching the pool filter.

## Which Cleaner Is Right for Your Vinyl Pool?


Choose based on your existing equipment, pool size, and typical debris:


- Choose a pressure-side cleaner if you collect lots of larger debris and already have, or plan to install, the necessary pressure line and booster pump.
- Choose a suction-side cleaner for a simpler setup that works through your existing pump and filter system.
- Choose a robotic cleaner for independent filtration, advanced cleaning features, and the most hands-off experience.
